ce_only.description: Same optimiser and schedule as PACT, cross-entropy objective only.

nimble_recipe.description: Published Nimble recipe inside this harness: plain candidate cross-entropy, one epoch, linear schedule, no extra views.

no_cf.description: Ablation: drop the counterfactual difference-in-differences margin.

no_emd.description: Ablation: drop the ordinal transport cost on Score fields.

no_pcr.description: Ablation: drop permutation consistency (keeps the permuted views as plain augmentation).

no_perm_views.description: Ablation: no permuted encodings at all (isolates augmentation from the consistency term).

pact_full.description: All four PACT terms, LoRA+ and rsLoRA, contextual temperature.
